payload.title: Holocene Ice Window Size
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook analyzes the size of ice windows during the Holocene epoch using paleoclimate data. It imports and processes datasets from the LiPD format, focusing on specific indices of interest within each dataset. The notebook employs various scientific computing libraries to load, manipulate, and visualize the data. The primary output is a series of processed datasets ready for further analysis or visualization.

section_blurbs.blurb: The section introduces the analysis of Holocene ice window size using paleoclimate data. It involves importing necessary libraries, loading datasets from a specified directory, and processing these datasets by focusing on specific indices of interest.
